title: Session Initialization Protocol
description: Mandatory steps each agent must take at the start of a conversation.

versions.body:
# Session Initialization

1. Call ToolSession.Generate.
2. Save the UUID.

<!-- earlier revision 1 -->

# Session Initialization

1. Call ToolSession.Generate with (agent, brief, task, project).
2. Save the UUID.

<!-- earlier revision 2 -->

# Session Initialization

1. Call ToolSession.Generate with (agent, brief, task, project).
2. Save the returned UUID as the session ID.
3. Use the UUID for all downstream tool calls requiring a session reference.
